title: Comparison span for effacing sequences
statement: Let F be a cohomological delta-functor [def-weil-pbc-delta-functor] between abelian categories [def-sp-abelian]. For two short exact sequences S,T effacing degree n+1 and a:S.X₁→T.X₁, there is a monomorphism w:S.X₁→Y effacing that degree and morphisms from its cokernel sequence to S and T with left components identity and a.

source.place: Lemma Tag 010T (lemma-efface-implies-universal), with its proof (induction on n through the cokernel description F^{n+1}(A)=Coker(F^n(B)->F^n(C)); the verification that t^{n+1} is a natural transformation is 'omitted' in Stacks and must be written out at the split)

proof.text:
Comparison span for effacing sequences.

Source: Stacks Project, Homology, Lemma 010T, omitted naturality verification;
the direct-sum argument is step 5 of the parent node. Form the embedding
w = (S.f, a ≫ T.f) into the biproduct. Projection onto the first factor proves
monicity. Additivity and the two effacement equations show F(w) = 0. The
projections followed by the quotient maps kill w, so they descend through its
cokernel and define the two morphisms of short exact sequences.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 010T, induction construction; the omitted independence, naturality and connecting-map compatibility verifications are supplied by J2 using the parent node direct-sum and pushout arguments.

lean.statement: theorem effacingSequence_comparison {A : Type u₁} {B : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} A] [Abelian A] [Category.{v₂} B] [Abelian B] (F : CohomologicalDeltaFunctor A B) (n : ℕ) (S T : ShortComplex A) (hS : S.ShortExact) (_hT : T.ShortExact) (hs : (F.F (n + 1)).map S.f = 0) (ht : (F.F (n + 1)).map T.f = 0) (a : S.X₁ ⟶ T.X₁) : ∃ (Y : A) (u : S.X₁ ⟶ Y), Mono u ∧ (F.F (n + 1)).map u = 0 ∧ ∃ (p : ShortComplex.cokernelSequence u ⟶ S) (q : ShortComplex.cokernelSequence u ⟶ T), p.τ₁ = 𝟙 S.X₁ ∧ q.τ₁ = a
